div.head: Rect 18, 18.1
div.ab: [18] Be bydele. Bydele gebyrað, þæt he for his wycan sy weorces frigra ðonne oðer man; forðan he sceal beon oftræde. [18.1] Eac him gebyreð sum landsticce for his geswince.
[18] Bedello pertinet, ut pro seruitio suo liberior sit ab operatione quam alii homines, quia sepius est impeditus. [18.1] Etiam ei conuenit, ut aliquam terre portiunculam habeat pro labore suo.
Be bydele . Bydele gebyrað þæt he for his wycan sy weorces frigra ðonne oðer man . forðan he sceal beon oftræde . eac him gebyreð sum landsticce for his geswince.

Concerning the beadle [The officer responsible for gathering men to council] To the beadle it is due that, on account of his office, he should be freer of work than other men, because he must be always available, also a portion of land is due to him for his labour.

[18] Vom Büttel. Dem Büttel gebührt, dass er für seine Amtsübung freier an Frohnarbeit als ein anderer [Guts]untergebener sei; denn er muss [der Domäne] oft bereit sein. [18.1] Auch gebührt ihm ein Stück Land [der Domäne] für seine Mühe.

[18] Of the beadle. To the beadle is due that, for his office, he be freer from labour-service than another [estate] dependant; for he must often be ready [for the demesne]. [18.1] Also a piece of [demesne] land is due to him for his trouble.
div.note: This row combines Liebermann's 18–18.1. Liebermann compares Rect 6.3.
